text: 1. At least 18 years of age, generally not more than 30 years of age (born before September 1, 1995);2. Non-chinese citizens holding valid foreign ordinary passports,Chinese citizens who apply for admission to colleges and universities as foreign students after immigration must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for more than 4 years (inclusive), and have a record of actual residence abroad for more than 2 years within the last 4 years (before April 30 of the year of enrollment) (actual residence abroad for more than 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, Subject to entry and exit signature);3. Fresh high school graduates or have a high school diploma, high school performance is good;4. Language proficiency: HSK Level 4 for Chinese-taught majors, TOEFL 80 or IELTS 5.5 for English-taught majors;5. No criminal record, no history of drug abuse;6. In good health, no major infectious diseases.
